My 53-year health record has over 7,000 entries from multiple clinics. Please review my chart and provide a cited summary covering all three parts below:
1. Medication & Staging Conflicts: Identify my duplicate cholesterol medications (Lipitor and Simvastatin), duplicate blood thinners (Plavix and Clopidogrel), and conflicting chronic kidney disease and diabetes staging entries alongside my August 2026 eGFR (47.95 mL/min/1.73m2).
2. Long-Standing Cardiometabolic Conditions: Confirm my documented Essential Hypertension and Metabolic Syndrome X diagnoses.
3. Cardiac Surgery, Sleep Apnea & Maintenance Regimen: State my November 2023 coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) history, my Sleep Apnea diagnosis, and my active Metoprolol Succinate 100 mg ER and Insulin 70/30 prescriptions.
